items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I used to (inaudible) tell Johnny Hodges, "Hey, sign him up, sign him up, we'll get him in the band."

ctx.x: Even after I left Chick Webb, I used to go back to the Apollo Theater when Duke was appearing there.
I used to (inaudible) tell Johnny Hodges, "Hey, sign him up, sign him up, we'll get him in the band."
Now, I know what he wanted. He wanted me for my bass clarinet. He wanted to do something with the bass sax. He always liked that bass sax.
